title: 台上的质疑  (Questioning the Verdict Onstage)

segments.t: Host Wen Simo welcomes Xin Huimei and opens the Twelve Singers semifinal while Chun Yuqiao directs cameras from the control room, until Huimei challenges the show onstage. Listen to their conversation first.
惠美老师，化妆间这边请。
欢迎大家来到十二歌王的现场！
现在我们的节目正式开始！
一号机准备，二号机看全景。
灯光准备，开始吧。
所有歌手的表演已经全部结束了。
白杨和倪徽，谁可以继续留在舞台呢？
下面有请导师辛惠美为我们点评。
我觉得选手白杨的声音非常美。
不过白杨刚才有点紧张，大家心里应该有结果了。
你们既然都有结果了，还要我点评干什么？
我的点评能改变结果吗？
Let's unpack what they say. Wen Simo first ushers Xin Huimei backstage and then opens the live taping.
惠美老师，化妆间这边请。
'Mentor Huimei, dressing room right this way please.' Guiding a guest with "zhebian qing", literally 'this side please', is polite hospitality you will hear in hotels, restaurants, and studios alike.
欢迎大家来到十二歌王的现场！
'Welcome everyone to the live studio of Twelve Singers!' Warm "huanying dajia" greets an audience or group of visitors, followed by "laidao", 'arrive at'.
现在我们的节目正式开始！
'Now our show officially begins!' Placing "zhengshi", 'officially', right before "kaishi", 'begin', gives a broadcast or ceremony a crisp opening.
一号机准备，二号机看全景。
'Camera one get ready, camera two take the wide shot.' Ordinal numbers form with "hao", 'number', so "yi hao ji" is 'camera one', while "quanjing" literally means 'full view' for a wide shot.
灯光准备，开始吧。
'Lights get ready, let us start.' Stage lighting is "dengguang", built from 'lamp' and 'light', paired with "zhunbei", 'get ready'.
所有歌手的表演已经全部结束了。
'All the singers have now finished their performances.' Stage performances are "biaoyan", and stacking "quanbu", 'entirely', before "jieshu le" emphasizes that every single singer is done.
白杨和倪徽，谁可以继续留在舞台呢？
'Between Bai Yang and Ni Hui, who can stay onstage?' Here "jixu" means 'continue', and "wutai" joins 'dance' with 'platform' as the everyday word for 'stage'.
下面有请导师辛惠美为我们点评。
'Next, please welcome mentor Xin Huimei to share her critique.' Hosts say "youqing" to invite a speaker or performer forward, and "dianping" means 'comment on' or 'critique'.
我觉得选手白杨的声音非常美。
'I think contestant Bai Yang has a very beautiful voice.' Competition entrants are "xuanshou", "shengyin" is 'voice' or 'sound', and "mei" means 'beautiful'.
不过白杨刚才有点紧张，大家心里应该有结果了。
'Though Bai Yang was a little nervous just now, everyone probably has a verdict in mind.' Putting "youdian" before an unpleasant feeling like "jinzhang", 'nervous', means 'a bit too nervous'.
你们既然都有结果了，还要我点评干什么？
'Since you already have a verdict, why ask me to critique at all?' Starting with "jiran", 'since', sets up a pointed challenge, and trailing "gan shenme" snaps 'what for?'.
我的点评能改变结果吗？
'Can my critique change the outcome?' Action word "gaibian" means 'change' or 'alter', paired with "jieguo", 'outcome' or 'result'. Now let us hear the whole conversation once more.
惠美老师，化妆间这边请。
欢迎大家来到十二歌王的现场！
现在我们的节目正式开始！
一号机准备，二号机看全景。
灯光准备，开始吧。
所有歌手的表演已经全部结束了。
白杨和倪徽，谁可以继续留在舞台呢？
下面有请导师辛惠美为我们点评。
我觉得选手白杨的声音非常美。
不过白杨刚才有点紧张，大家心里应该有结果了。
你们既然都有结果了，还要我点评干什么？
我的点评能改变结果吗？

Instead, of playing along with the script, Xin Huimei challenges the show live onstage in front of the entire studio audience. You learned "zhebian qing" to guide a guest, "zhengshi kaishi" to open an event, and "gaibian jieguo" for changing an outcome. See you next time!
下次见！
